title: Ragnar Vizsla
description: Ragnar Vizsla, a Mandalorian boy and son of Paz Vizsla, was abducted by a shriek-hawk and rescued by Bo-Katan Kryze who eventually led him and his father back to Mandalore. There on Mandalore, he was able to bathe in the living waters and complete his oath in order to become a full-fledged Mandalorian.
